source: Shapes taken from Twilio's own published packages: the <Connect action>, <Dial action timeout callerId> and <Number url> attributes in twilio 6.1.2 (lib/twiml/VoiceResponse.d.ts: ConnectAttributes, DialAttributes, NumberAttributes), and the request Twilio sends to the <Connect action> URL when a speech relay session ends in twilio-agent-connect 2.4.0 (dist/index.d.ts: ConversationRelayCallbackPayloadSchema, with HandoffData described in PendingHandoffDataSchema's comment). The whisper and dial-ended requests (ParentCallSid, DialCallStatus) are not in either package: their fields are taken from Twilio's standard voice request parameters, and DialCallStatus is assumed to take the same values as CallStatus. The values are made up. Not yet checked against a live call (lesson L-016): replace this with captured requests from the first live transfer.
